text: My husband and I have eaten at Pha Khao in Racine, WI several times, and enjoyed it. During previous visits, the service was good. This time, it was the opposite. We arrived with another couple for an early dinner, but all the tables were full. The owner did not greet us, nor did he say how long we'd have to wait. Looking tense, he told a couple of teenage girls in black to vacate a table for four, and began cleaning it. The girls went behind the bar and began laughing and talking loudly. The owner gestured us to the table and we sat down, then he served water. Another teenaged girl appeared to take our drink orders. She looked grumpy, and was dressed in an overlarge t-shirt, baggy pajama bottoms, and what looked like bedroom scuffs. My husband tried to tease a smile from her, but she only lifted the corners of her mouth. The owner came out to verify my choice of Chateau Ste. Michelle cabernet, but he didn't understand which wine I asked for. He brought the bottle to the table to make certain, which was kind of him. The grumpy teen came back for our food orders: my husband chose Crisp Noodles with Chicken, and I asked for Shrimp and Basil Noodles. She entered our choices on a handheld machine, and left. The teens who were making noise behind the bar finally disappeared. Our food came in a reasonable time, except for my Shrimp and Basil Noodles, which somehow had turned into Shrimp Fried Rice. I refused that dish, and told the teen what I'd originally ordered. The owner came over, and I told him what had happened. He took the Shrimp Fried Rice back to the kitchen and put in my original order. It was served by the woman who was cooking, who had waited on us during a previous visit. The food was delicious. When we finished and packed the leftovers into to-go boxes, my husband went to the bar, called for the cook, and personally gave her the tip. It will be a while before we dine here again: by that time, perhaps the owner will find competent servers.

L’hotel si trova a circa 1 km dal centro di Pescasseroli, . La stanza è nela norna, ma all’ingresso si percepisce un forte odore di chiuso: ho dovuto lasciare la finestra aperta per un po’. La posizione del televisore è scomoda, fissato su una parete perpendicolare al letto con un angolo assurdo che rende difficile guardarlo senza affaticare gli occhi. bagno curato e letti nella norma.

Spa: motivo principale per cui avevo scelto l’hotel, ma esperienza completamente deludente. Nonostante il prezzo contenuto, il percorso – composto da vasca idromassaggio, bagno turco, sauna finlandese e doccia emozionale – presenta gravi problemi:
	•	Rumore assordante all’interno, con musica radiofonica totalmente inadatta all’ambiente.
	•	Bagno turco con soffio eccessivamente forte simile a un treno a vapore; doccia malfunzionante e percorso  emozionale con scarsissima erogazione d’acqua. Inoltre, il bagno turco si spegne automaticamente dopo 20–30 minuti, impedendo di completare il percorso a piacimento.
	•	Sauna pubblicizzata come "finlandese" ma  la temperatura interna non supera i 60 °C sulle pedane alte. Troppo bassa!
	•	Mancano lettini per il relax e acqua  a disposizione per bere, e il tempo massimo di utilizzo è limitato a un’ora, rendendo l’esperienza stressante invece che rigenerante.

Ho segnalato gentilmente questi problemi alla gestione, ma non sono stato preso in considerazione né rimborsato. Andavo lì proprio per la spa, e sono uscito dopo appena trenta minuti più stressato di prima.
